## 1. Vendor Profile
PayRail Inc. is a licensed payment processor headquartered in Toronto providing cross-border payout services. PayRail acts as the third-party processor for beneficiary payout and currency conversion.

Coverage for this engagement includes Canada and Mexico.

## 3. Compliance Program
PayRail has excellent AML controls and a mature compliance program.
